notes: Two-authority publication model (non-circular): authorized_pr_head / -PrHead is the executable tooling freeze (runtime/pin identity). bundle_source_commit is the immutable commit whose tree contains the finalized standalone bundle blob sealed by tip authorization. Bootstrap materializes the bundle from ${bundle_source_commit}:${standalone_bundle.path}, never from ${freeze}:${path}. The tip commit that only pins bundle_source_commit may be a descendant of the bundle-source commit so tip authorization never needs to embed its own commit SHA inside the bundle.
authorized_pr_head is the executable tooling freeze commit (set in pin publication).
Pass --pr-head equal to authorized_pr_head (tooling freeze), not the evidence tip or bundle_source_commit.
Launcher/bootstrap materializes standalone_bundle from sealed bundle_source_commit git blobs before any DB connection; freeze-tree stale bundles are never selected.
bundle_source_commit and standalone_bundle seals are tip-authorization only — never argv, environment, worktree, prior evidence, or operator override.
TLS trust root is the freeze-sealed embedded official Supabase CA (DER-pinned); FREE_REVIEW_LEAD_SESSION_APPLY_SSL_ROOTCERT is forbidden.

Migration git cat-file authority (LF): OID 7dca9674673eb51ab5094d3ec09508d0711f16cd, SHA-256 b7e1e68b82a5975e85e1b9d6f0c491fa632474801ce00b311cea366f3b9b0ddb, bytes 8108 at artifact_commit b2c431fa4310f58c9ee667e858333e084c2fed52.
Operator-supplied CRLF worktree measurements (c4e34759f61f27781950295767fca3c3e2136eb8682a72e7f84d8d363e94f0ed / 8314 bytes) are NOT applicator pins; git blob OID is LF authority.

Native Windows Job Object containment lives in visible_ceremony_supervisor: it creates the job with ONLY JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE (0x2000) via the FrlsVisible.JobApi P/Invoke surface, starts the entry CREATE_SUSPENDED, AssignProcessToJobObject, then ResumeThread. BREAKAWAY flags are never set; assign failure kills the suspended child without resuming.

SecureString credential ceremony lives in operator_ceremony and operator_apply_ceremony: Read-Host -AsSecureString, SecureStringToBSTR/PtrToStringBSTR, ZeroFreeBSTR, process-env handoff only, cleared on every outcome. The URL never reaches argv, chat, logs, or emitted evidence.

System32 PowerShell resolution (absolute %SystemRoot%\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe, reparse-point and PATH-shim rejected) is enforced in supervisor, visible entry, visible launcher, and both operator ceremonies before any child process starts.

Visible ceremony: run visible_ceremony_supervisor with -CeremonyKind dry-run|apply; it materializes visible_ceremony_entry from tip under the Job Object. CeremonyKind dry-run selects operator_ceremony; apply selects operator_apply_ceremony. Missing/unknown kind fails before PROMPT_READY.
Enter materializes launcher + the seal-selected ceremony from freeze blobs only; never execute mutable worktree scripts as authority.

FRLS has no fixture Target #2 world: the ceremonies forward only the sealed apply token, and FRLS_CEREMONY_ALLOW_SYNTHETIC_URL is the single harness channel (loopback 127.0.0.1 only, never on the interactive SecureString path).
CONTAINMENT_APPLY_DATABASE_URL is not an FRLS channel; both operator ceremonies fail closed with BLOCKED_RETIRED_CREDENTIAL_CHANNEL if it is set, and the visible chain clears it.

required_prior_dry_run_evidence_sha256 / required_prior_dry_run_freeze / required_prior_dry_run_evidence_tip / required_prior_dry_run_bundle_source are published from the authorized production dry-run (evidence SHA b27e927b…, freeze 7e4d4e4b…, tip d0813452…, bundle source 823b4664…). Apply ceremony, visible entry, and supervisor require -PriorDryRunEvidencePath and Assert-PriorDryRunEvidence against these sealed pins. Pins cannot be overridden via argv, environment, worktree files, alternate evidence paths, or operator input. Rejected: closed headless attempt; superseded evidence e5202a46….

Child evidence frame is FRLS_LEAD_SESSION_EVIDENCE_V1; the FRLS evidence module requires the shared framing primitives in evidence_protocol.shared_framing_module, which ceremonies materialize as a sibling before decoding.
Supervisor hard-kill residual: no V1 frame; job handle closure still kills the contained process tree.

Prior-dry-run verdict gate: shared scripts/security/free-review-lead-session-prior-dry-run-gates.ps1; allowlist DRY_RUN_READY_FOR_SEPARATE_APPLY_AUTHORIZATION and historical DRY_RUN_READY. Mandatory booleans/counters fail closed when missing, null, wrong-type, or inferred.

Never load from $PSScriptRoot or mutable worktree.
Assert-PriorDryRunEvidence requires full sealed dry-run evidence contract including history 186 and migration LF seals.
Mandatory booleans (including advisory_lock_acquired on wrapper and applicator) and counters fail closed when missing, null, wrong-type, or inferred; no default-false success path.
